ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with approximately 25-30% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels appearing in a mottled and ringed distribution across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white/light gray pixel clusters form numerous circular rings and irregular blobs concentrated in the medial regions of both lobes, surrounded by contiguous low-intensity dark regions that extend to the trailing edge and central notch area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 125 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to the fluke width of roughly 1:8.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations indicate irregular peaks and valleys, particularly prominent on the mid-section of the right lobe lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, tapered points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed circular high-contrast white rings (diameters ranging from 3 to 15 pixels) across both lobes, characteristic of barnacle attachment scarring; significant cluster observed on the inner-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, unaligned linear white pixel disruption is visible on the lower medial portion of the left lobe, oriented diagonally toward the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) across the entire ventral surface; irregular jaggedness of the trailing edge suggesting multiple minor acquired trauma points.
other_distinctive_markers: The density and clarity of the circular 'ring-like' scar patterns provide a unique, highly localized visual texture across the dark pigmentation of the fluke lobes.
